statisticalMethod: Per (epoch, workload, metric): median and nearest-rank p95 over independent fresh-process samples, each with a distribution-free 95% order-statistic interval (null = unbounded at this n). Incremental edits: one value per sample (median of warm iterations, iteration 0 excluded); pooledIterations also summarizes every warm iteration for the tail. Epoch comparisons: per-round paired ratios candidate/reference (adjacent samples of the same round, workload and kind); median of ratios with a seeded (307) 2,000-round percentile bootstrap over pairs. Deterministic metrics must be identical across samples.
